_comment: Art prompts for No. 21, written 2026-11-02, rewritten the same day after Andy's two notes: no blank paper backgrounds, color and action to the frame edge; and only the Ear's inks (black, cream, rust, pine, a little gold, no teal or blue) in woodcut stipple print. Generated in ChatGPT Image at chatgpt.com in the built-in browser pane, then optimized to public/assets/spots/no21_<file> at 900 px, JPEG q84. Prefix in ChatGPT: 'Generate an image, 1:1 aspect ratio.' (3:2 for the feature).
suffix: Style: a hand-carved woodcut stipple print from an old local newspaper: bold black carved lines, dense stipple dots and gouged hatching, visible block-print grain, flat ink colors with no gradients and no airbrushing. Strictly five inks and nothing else: black #171512, cream #F3E8D2, rust red #A94A34, dark pine green #315D54, and a little gold #D8A725 for small details only. Skin is cream shaded with black and rust stipple. No teal, no blue, no purple, no orange, no bright green, no other colors. The inks fill the frame edge to edge with no blank paper background, and the subject is huge, in motion and runs off the frame. Not a photograph, not a painting, not flat vector. No text or letters anywhere.

ambc-fall-fest.prompt: A woodcut stipple print: the Great Smoky Mountains as a background plate with nothing in front of it. Layer upon layer of long rolling ridgelines receding into the distance in the lower 40 percent of the picture, rising gently from left to right, the nearest ridge black with a stippled tree line, the ones behind it dark pine green, with bands of cream mist in the valleys between them. Above the ridges, huge carved sunburst rays in rust and cream radiate up from behind the mountains and fill the whole sky to the top edge of the frame, with a thin gold glow along the highest ridge. No people, no bikes, no buildings, no sun disc, no birds.
ambc-fall-fest.note: This prompt is the background plate only. The rider is the first ChatGPT rider, kept at Andy's request (2026-11-02), composited over the plate with its teal moved to pine.

latin-knox-printshop.prompt: A woodcut stipple print: a laughing young woman DJ with wild black curls flying, big gold hoop earrings swinging, one arm flung high with a finger pointed up, the other hand on the mixer, cropped tight from the chest up with black mixer knobs huge along the bottom edge and headphones around her neck, a pine green top. Behind her, carved sunburst rays in rust and cream fill the frame.

808-college-night.prompt: A woodcut stipple print: a young man with shaggy gold-blond hair whipping sideways, mouth wide open mid-scream into a microphone, eyes shut, sweat flying off him, a rust red electric guitar neck slashing diagonally across the corner, a pine green shirt, cropped tight from the shoulders up and seen from his right. Behind him solid black cut by carved rust spotlight beams.

sokno-sourdough-first-friday.prompt: A woodcut stipple print: a delighted woman with gray-streaked hair in a bun and a pine green apron pouring a thick glossy ribbon of black chocolate tonic from a small bottle into a tiny cup held up by another person's hand, the pour huge in the center of the frame, droplets leaping and broken chocolate squares tumbling through the air, cropped tight from her shoulders up. Behind her a solid rust field with carved cream rays.

cut-corners-fbn.prompt: A woodcut stipple print: a joyful dancer with a shaved head and a huge laughing grin, both arms thrown up and hands open, caught mid-jump with sweat flying and a gold chain necklace swinging up off the chest, wearing a black mesh tank top, cropped tight from the chest up with hands running off the top of the frame. Behind, solid black crossed by carved rust and pine beams of light and stipple sparkle.

bow-wow-bingo-printshop.prompt: A woodcut stipple print: a gleeful gray-muzzled beagle in cream, rust and black, floppy ears flying, front paws up on a picnic table, holding a bingo dauber crosswise in its grinning mouth, rust ink dabs splattering across the cream bingo card in the foreground, the dog's head filling the frame and its ears running off the edges. Behind, a solid pine green ground and a beer glass with a gold glint.

uptop-karaoke-kerns.prompt: A woodcut stipple print: a man with a thick black beard and backwards cap belting into a wireless microphone with both hands wrapped around it, head thrown back, eyes squeezed shut, a friend's beer raised and sloshing at the frame edge, a rust and black plaid flannel shirt, cropped tight from the chest up at a three-quarter angle. Behind him a solid pine night with swooping strings of small gold patio bulbs.

all-play-live-kerns.prompt: A woodcut stipple print: a girl of about eight with two flying black braids and a gap-toothed grin slamming both hands down on a huge round game-show buzzer, her father's hand landing a moment too late beside hers, the rust red dome enormous in the foreground with carved shock lines bursting off it, her eyes wide with glee, a pine and cream striped shirt, cropped tight from the shoulders up. Behind her carved rays in pine and cream with small gold bulbs.

goat-yoga-kerns.prompt: A woodcut stipple print: a small black-and-cream goat with a tiny rust bow tie leaping joyfully off the back of a laughing woman in tabletop pose, all four hooves in the air and ears flapping, the goat huge in the upper frame, her delighted face with short rust red hair turned toward us just below it, a cream long-sleeve top and full-length black leggings, cropped close so goat and woman fill the frame. Behind them a solid pine green hillside rising to a rust sky.

moss-meander.prompt: A woodcut stipple print: a grinning older man with a white beard, a black knit cap and a rust red scarf, lying on his stomach right up against a boulder and holding a small gold jeweler's hand lens up to one twinkling eye, his other hand pointing at a tiny moss stalk, cropped from the chest up. Dense pine green moss with tiny rust-tipped stalks piles up huge in the foreground, and a deep pine forest with carved cream shafts of light stands behind him.

wilderness-basics.prompt: A woodcut stipple print: a young woman with a dark ponytail and a thrilled grin leaning over a nest of tinder, striking a ferro rod with a knife spine so a huge shower of rust and gold sparks explodes across the frame and the first flames leap up, lighting her face from below, a pine green wool sweater, cropped tight so her face, hands and the fire fill the frame. Behind her solid black night with flying embers.

bird-banding.prompt: A woodcut stipple print: a yellow-rumped warbler in black, cream and small gold patches held gently in a bander's fingers, its head and bright alert eye huge in the frame, beak open mid-chirp, feathers crisply carved, a second hand closing a tiny band around its leg with small pliers, extreme close-up. Behind it a solid pine ground scattered with falling rust autumn leaves.

sound-bath-ijams.prompt: A woodcut stipple print: a woman with long cream-white hair floating outward, eyes closed and a blissful smile, circling a suede mallet around the rim of a large crystal singing bowl resting on a rust cushion in front of her, big carved gold rings of sound rippling out from the rim through the whole picture and lifting her hair, cropped from the chest up. Behind her a solid pine night with stipple stars.

specials-board.prompt: A woodcut stipple print: a tall rust red cocktail in a highball glass slammed down on a bar by a bartender's hand so juice and ice splash up and out in a huge frozen crown, a gold citrus wheel flying off the rim, a black-and-cream football spiraling past behind it, extreme close-up with the glass filling the frame. Behind it a bold rust and cream end-zone checkerboard fills the frame edge to edge, no logos.
